title: Room to Room
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about getting from one room to another. A door leads out of one room and into the next, a house has doors that go back the way you came, and a fork has two doors to two rooms. Signs in the rooms say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and move a door.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks out of one room and into the next. First a door, then an open archway, then a house with doors that go there and back, and last a fork with two doors to choose from. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and move where a door lands.
features: Signs in the rooms explain each idea
A door is a link: touch it, and you arrive in another room
Made to be copied and taken apart
